children: Indonesia's imports surged 27.02% year-on-year to USD 26.09 billion in July 2026, exceeding expectations of 24.1% but slowing from a 34.27% increase in June, which was the strongest import growth since July 2022, amid higher oil prices.
Non-oil and gas imports rose 6.84% year-on-year to USD 25.43 billion, while oil and gas imports fell 14.58% year-on-year to USD 0.79 billion.

title: Indonesia Imports Rise More than Estimated
